PiKraṬi: [p. 15] namo vajrasattvāya | āryanāgārjunapādakṛtapiṇḍīkramasya yathā bhāvanākramas tatheha sūcyate || prathamaṃ tāvad aṭavyādau manorame sthāne sukhāsanastho yogī | vikalpavāsanādoṣadūṣitān sarvasattvān samabhivīkṣya | taduddharaṇavāñchāsvabhāvāṃ mahākaruṇām āmukhīkṛtya |
analyzed: namaḥ vajra sattvāya ārya nāgārjuna pāda kṛta piṇḍī kramasya yathā bhāvanā kramaḥ tathā iha sūcyate prathamam tāvat aṭavī ādau manorame sthāne sukha āsana sthaḥ yogī vikalpa vāsanā doṣa dūṣitān sarva sattvān samabhivīkṣya tad uddharaṇa vāñchā svabhāvām mahā karuṇām ā mukhīkṛtya

original: oṃ svabhāvaśuddhāḥ sarvadharmāḥ svabhāvaśuddho 'ham ity uccārya śūnyatālambanena prākṛtāhaṃkāram apanīya | ātmānaṃ jhaṭiti vajrasattvarūpaṃ niṣpādya | vajradhṛg iti samuccārya | tenākṣobhyaṃ samutsṛjya | ātmani praveśya tryakṣareṇa kavacaṃ kṛtvā | anena krameṇa «dveṣavajrasamādhisthaḥ sthānarakṣāṃ samārabhed» (7cd) iti |
analyzed: om svabhāva śuddhāḥ sarva dharmāḥ svabhāva śuddhaḥ ham iti uccārya śūnyatā ālambanena prākṛta ahaṃkāram apanīya ātmānam jhaṭiti vajra sattva rūpam niṣpādya vajradhṛk iti samuccārya tena akṣobhyam samutsṛjya ātmani praveśya tri akṣareṇa kavacam kṛtvā anena krameṇa dveṣa vajra samādhi sthaḥ sthāna rakṣām samārabhet iti

original: tato akṣobhyahṛdbījād daśa krodhān saṃskārya [= saṃsphārya] | dvitīyaṃ śumbham ājñāpya mantreṇa | dvitīyamantreṇa punar ājñāṃ dattvā tenaiva ca mantreṇa sumbhena kīlayed vighnān | tataḥ kīlakād bahiḥ ṭakkir hūṃjaḥ | iti mantreṇa | loha [?] | jala | agni | vāyu | prākārāṃś cintayed ity āmnāyaḥ |
analyzed: tatas akṣobhya hṛd bījāt daśa krodhān saṃskārya saṃsphārya dvitīyam śumbham ājñāpya mantreṇa dvitīya mantreṇa punar ājñām dattvā tena eva ca mantreṇa sumbhena kīlayet vighnān tatas kīlakāt bahis ṭakkiḥ hūṃjaḥ iti mantreṇa loha jala agni vāyu prākārān cintayet iti āmnāyaḥ

original: tadanu bhrūṃkāram uccārya tatpariṇāmataś caityākāraṃ vajrapañjaraṃ dṛṣṭvā | tanmadhye svabhāvetyādinā gāthārthena śūnyatāṃ cintayed iti | tato mahākaruṇayā prabodhitaḥ san yaṃkārajaṃ vāyumaṇḍalaṃ dhanurākṛti | hūṃkāradvayena pārśvayor vajrāṅkitaṃ paśyet | evam agnivaruṇapṛthivīmaṇḍalāni | eṣāṃ pariṇāmena viśvavajramayabhūbhāgaṃ dṛṣṭvā |
analyzed: tadanu bhrūṃkāram uccārya tad pariṇāmataḥ caitya ākāram vajra pañjaram dṛṣṭvā tad madhye svabhāva ityādinā gāthā arthena śūnyatām cintayet iti tatas mahā karuṇayā prabodhitaḥ san yaṃkāra jam vāyu maṇḍalam dhanuḥ ākṛti hūṃkāra dvayena pārśvayoḥ vajra aṅkitam paśyet evam agni varuṇa pṛthivī maṇḍalāni eṣām pariṇāmena viśva vajra maya bhū bhāgam dṛṣṭvā

original: tadupari bhrūṃkārajaṃ kūṭāgāraṃ viśvapadmasthacandrārūḍhaṃ māṇḍaleyānāṃ cakrāsanādyanvitaṃ dhyātvā | madhye hūṃ oṃ āḥ || ity akṣaratrayeṇa sūryacandraviśvapadmakiñjalkacandre punas tryakṣaraṃ dṛṣṭvā etat sarvaṃ pariṇamya jhaṭiti dvātriṃśaddevatāparivṛtaṃ vajrasattvarūpam ātmānam abhinirmāya |
analyzed: tad upari bhrūṃkāra jam kūṭāgāram viśva padma stha candra ārūḍham māṇḍaleyānām cakra āsana ādi anvitam dhyātvā madhye hūm om āḥ iti akṣara trayeṇa sūrya candra viśva padma kiñjalka candre punar tri akṣaram dṛṣṭvā etat sarvam pariṇamya jhaṭiti dvātriṃśat devatā parivṛtam vajra sattva rūpam ātmānam abhinirmāya

original: tān māṇḍaleyān skandhādiṣu bhāvena skandhādiṣu līnān dṛṣṭvā paramārthamaṇḍale praveśayet | rūpaskandhetyādinā tad darśayati | ādarśasvabhāvo vairocanaḥ | bhūdhātur locanā | nayanendriyam iti kṣitigarbhaḥ | rūpaṃ ceti rūpavajrā | maitreyo 'pi yamāntakācalābhyāṃ saha vajradhare 'ntarbhavati | vedanāskandhasamatā ratnasaṃbhavaḥ | abdhātur māmakī |
analyzed: tān māṇḍaleyān skandha ādiṣu bhāvena skandha ādiṣu līnān dṛṣṭvā paramārtha maṇḍale praveśayet rūpa skandha ityādinā tat darśayati ādarśa svabhāvaḥ vairocanaḥ bhūdhātuḥ locanāḥ nayana indriyam iti kṣiti garbhaḥ rūpam ca iti rūpa vajrāḥ yama antaka acalābhyām saha vajradhare ntarbhavati vedanā skandha samatā ratna saṃbhavaḥ ap dhātuḥ māmakī

original: idānīṃ māmakī ratnakulī smṛtā | paścād akṣyobhyakulībhaviṣyati kuladvaye 'py āvaraṇaṃ yatra | śravaṇendriyaṃ khagarbhaḥ | śabdavajrā ca | [p. 16] krodhadvayam iti prajñāntakaṭakkirājau | saṃjñā ca pratyavekṣaṇyam ity amitābhaḥ | hutabhuk pāṇḍaravāsinī | nāsikendriyaṃ lokeśaḥ | gandhavajrā ca | krodhadvayasamanvitam iti | padmāntakanīladaṇḍau |
analyzed: idānīm māmakī ratnakulī smṛtā paścāt kula dvaye pi āvaraṇam yatra śravaṇa indriyam khagarbhaḥ śabdavajrā ca krodha dvayam iti prajñāntaka ṭakkirājau saṃjñā ca pratyavekṣaṇyam iti amitābhaḥ hutabhuj pāṇḍaravāsinī nāsikā indriyam lokeśaḥ gandhavajrā ca krodha dvaya samanvitam iti padmāntaka nīladaṇḍau

original: saṃskārāḥ kṛtyānuṣṭhānam amoghasiddhiḥ | māruta iti tārā | rasanendriyam iti sarvaṇīvaraṇaviṣkambhī | rasavajrā ca | krodhadvayasamanvitam iti | vighnāntakamahābalau | ūdhvādhaḥkrodhadvayasaṃyuktam iti | uṣṇīṣaśumbhau | jñānatrayasvabhāvamana-indriyasvabhāvo mañjughoṣaḥ | upalakṣaṇatvād vajrapāṇisamantabhadrāv api draṣṭavyau |
analyzed: saṃskārāḥ kṛtyā anuṣṭhānam amoghasiddhiḥ mārutaḥ iti tārā rasana indriyam iti rasavajrā ca krodha dvaya samanvitam iti vighnāntaka mahābalau ūdhva adhas krodha dvaya saṃyuktam iti uṣṇīṣa śumbhau jñāna traya svabhāvam anaindriya svabhāvaḥ mañjughoṣaḥ upalakṣaṇa tvāt vajrapāṇi samantabhadrau api draṣṭavyau

original: tatra maitreyakṣitigarbhau vairocanakulinau bhavataḥ | ratnakulī khagarbhaḥ | amitābhakulī lokeśaḥ | amoghasiddhikulī sarvanivaraṇaviṣkambhī | śeṣās tu trayo 'kṣobhyakulina ity evaṃ jñātavyam | tataḥ oṃ śūnyatājñānavajrasvabhāvātmako 'ham ity uccārya vajrasattvam api darpaṇaśvāsakrameṇa prabhāsvare praveśayann anupalambham āviśati |
analyzed: tatra maitreya kṣitigarbhau vairocana kulinau bhavataḥ ratnakulī khagarbhaḥ amitābhakulī lokeśaḥ amoghasiddhikulī sarvanivaraṇaviṣkambhī śeṣāḥ tu trayaḥ kṣobhya kulinaḥ iti evam jñātavyam tatas om śūnyatā jñāna vajra svabhāva ātmakaḥ ham iti uccārya vajra sattvam api darpaṇa śvāsa krameṇa prabhāsvare praveśayan anupalambham āviśati

original: tataḥ pūrvapraṇidhānākṣepād ṛgiti sūcitaṃ sūryamaṇḍalākāreṇa pariṇataṃ tadupari candraṃ padmaṃ tryakṣaraṃ ca | etat sarvaṃ pariṇamya candram | candrāt punas tryakṣarasaṃbhūtaṃ sitavajraṃ vajrān mahāvajradharam | akṣobhyānupraveśena nyāsaṃ vicintayed iti | tatra oṃ āḥ hūṃ svā hā kārān mastakādiṣu vinyasya |
analyzed: tatas pūrva praṇidhāna ākṣepāt ṛc iti sūcitam sūrya maṇḍala ākāreṇa pariṇatam tad upari candram padmam tri akṣaram ca etat sarvam pariṇamya candram candrāt punar tri akṣara saṃbhūtam sita vajram vajrāt mahā vajradharam akṣobhya anupraveśena nyāsam vicintayet iti tatra om āḥ   svā hā kārān mastaka ādiṣu vinyasya

original: lāṃ māṃ yāṃ tāṃ brūṃ śaṃ gaṃ syaṃ pṛthivyādiṣu vinyasya | cakṣurādiṣu thīṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ ūṃ maiṃ saṃ vinyasya | daśa hūṃkārān yamāntakādyān bhujādiṣu vinyasya | tatra dakṣiṇavāmabhujayor yamāntakāparājitau | mukhe hayagrīvam | guhye 'mṛtakuṇḍalim | dakṣiṇavāmabāhvor acalaṭakkirājau | dakṣiṇavāmajānvor nīladaṇḍamahābalau |
analyzed: lām mām yām tām brūṃ śam gaṃ syaṃ pṛthivī ādiṣu vinyasya cakṣuḥ ādiṣu thīṃ om om om   ūm maiṃ sam vinyasya daśa hūṃkārān yamāntaka ādyān bhuja ādiṣu vinyasya tatra dakṣiṇa vāma bhujayoḥ yamāntaka aparājitau mukhe hayagrīvam guhye mṛta kuṇḍalim dakṣiṇa vāma bāhvoḥ acala ṭakki rājau dakṣiṇa vāma jānvoḥ nīladaṇḍa mahābalau

original: uṣṇīṣacakravartinaṃ mūrdhni | pādayoḥ sumbharājam | tadanu kāyavākcittādhiṣṭhānaṃ ca kṛtvā | samayasattvasya hṛdi jñānasattvaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavarṇam | vajravajraghaṇṭādharam | samāpannam | tasya ca hṛdi samādhisattvasaṃjñakaṃ hūṃkāraṃ nyaset | tato bāhyāṅganāyā rajakakulātmikāyā jñānamudrāyā vā skandhādikaṃ saṃśodhya vajrapadmasaṃskāraṃ ca kṛtvā |
analyzed: uṣṇīṣa cakra vartinam mūrdhni pādayoḥ sumbha rājam tadanu kāya vāc citta adhiṣṭhānam ca kṛtvā samaya sattvasya hṛdi jñānasattvam dvi bhujam rakta varṇam vajra vajra ghaṇṭā dharam samāpannam tasya ca hṛdi samādhi sattva saṃjñakam hūṃkāram nyaset tatas bāhya aṅganāyāḥ rajaka kula ātmikāyāḥ jñānamudrāyāḥ vā skandha ādikam saṃśodhya vajrapadma saṃskāram ca kṛtvā

original: tābhyāṃ samāpattiṃ kuryāt | tatra hūṃkāreṇa pañcasūcikaṃ vajram | madhyasūcau praṇavam | āḥkāreṇa dharmodayamadhya aṣṭadalapadmaṃ raktavarṇaṃ vicintayed iti | vajrapadmasaṃskāraḥ | cumbanāliṅganakrameṇa ratnasaṃbhavāhaṃkāreṇānurāgayet | bodhicittāvasthāyām [= bodhicittakṣarāvasthāyām?] amoghasiddher ahaṃkāraṃ kuryāt |
analyzed: tābhyām samāpattim kuryāt tatra hūṃkāreṇa pañca sūcikam vajram madhya sūcau praṇavam āḥkāreṇa dharma udaya madhye aṣṭadala padmam rakta varṇam vicintayet iti vajra padma saṃskāraḥ cumbana āliṅgana krameṇa ratnasaṃbhava ahaṃkāreṇa anurāgayet bodhi citta avasthāyām bodhi citta kṣara avasthāyām amoghasiddheḥ ahaṃkāram kuryāt

original: tato bodhicittāt [...?] prajñāravinde jhaṭiti prajñābhavotpattikrameṇa [p. 17] maṇḍalacakram utsṛjed dvātriṃśaddevatātmakam | tadanu guhyamaṇḍalād bāhyotsargamaṇḍalaṃ vajradhṛg ityādimantreṇa pratyekaṃ saṃskārya [= saṃsphārya] sattvānāṃ dveṣādiviśuddhiṃ vidhāyālaṃkṛtya ca krameṇa yathoktamaṇḍalacakrākāreṇopaviṣṭaṃ cintayet |
analyzed: tatas bodhi cittāt prajñā aravinde jhaṭiti prajñā bhava utpatti krameṇa maṇḍala cakram utsṛjet dvātriṃśat devatā ātmakam tadanu guhya maṇḍalāt bāhya utsarga maṇḍalam vajradhṛk ityādi mantreṇa pratyekam saṃskārya saṃsphārya sattvānām dveṣa ādi viśuddhim vidhāya alaṃkṛtya ca krameṇa yathā ukta maṇḍala cakra ākāreṇa upaviṣṭam cintayet

original: kiṃ tu madhye nāyakavajradharātmani dveṣavajraṃ praviṣṭaṃ cintayet | sparśavajrātmani sparśavajrāṃ praviṣṭāṃ cintayed iti | hūṃkārādibījākṣarasmaraṇena vā | tato jñānacakrapraveśābhiṣekānurāgaṇādikaṃ jhaṭiti cintayet |
analyzed: kim tu madhye nāyaka vajradhara ātmani dveṣa vajram praviṣṭam cintayet sparśa vajra ātmani sparśa vajrām praviṣṭām cintayet iti hūṃkāra ādi bīja akṣara smaraṇena vā tatas jñānacakra praveśa abhiṣeka anurāgaṇa ādikam jhaṭiti cintayet

original: tato vajrajāpādikaṃ kṛtvā codanāstutyādipūrvakaṃ samādhisattvātmakaṃ hūṃkāroccāraṇena sattvān hūṃkāre praveśya māṇḍaleyān saṃharet | tatraiva | tanniṣpannaṃ viśvavajrasattvaṃ paśyaṃś ca vihared iti || samāptā piṇḍīkramaṭippaṇī
analyzed: tatas vajra jāpa ādikam kṛtvā codanā stuti ādi pūrvakam samādhi sattva ātmakam hūṃkāra uccāraṇena sattvān hūṃkāre praveśya māṇḍaleyān saṃharet tatra eva tat niṣpannam viśva vajra sattvam paśyan ca viharet iti samāptā piṇḍīkrama ṭippaṇī
